qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global leader in high-voltage subsea and underground power transmission cables with a specialized installation fleet (Leonardo da Vinci, Monna Lisa) and unmatched turnkey project delivery. Median GAAP ROIC is 13.8% and tangible ROIC is 27.4%. Raw material costs (copper, aluminum) are contractually indexed, insulating project margins. Primary erosion threats include execution delays on complex deepwater installations, supply chain bottlenecks for high-voltage insulation materials, and post-merger integration risks from the Encore Wire acquisition.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global leader in high-voltage power transmission cables and subsea interconnectors backed by a specialized installation vessel fleet, multi-year record order backlogs, 13.8% median ROIC, and 137% FCF conversion. Pristine balance sheet with net debt repayable in 2.1 years and 8.5x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: transmission grid volume 4.5% + Encore Wire US integration 2.0% + contract price indexation 1.5% - cyclical installation timing drag 0.5% + share repurchases 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated revenue reached EUR 19.65B in FY2025 with EBIT of EUR 1,874M and Net Income of EUR 1,270M. GAAP ROIC has averaged 13.8% over the multi-year cycle (11.1% in FY22, 13.9% in FY23, 13.7% in FY24, 16.2% in FY25) with operating tangible ROIC of 27.4%. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion is 137% (EUR 1.43B FCF in FY25). Leverage remains sound with Net Debt of EUR 2,668M (LT debt EUR 4,693M minus EUR 2,025M cash), representing 2.1x net debt to net income, and interest coverage of 8.5x.
